annotations.text:
claude-limits · page served by the local backend at 127.0.0.1:7391.
Chosen direction: the compact dark list (variant C). Two views of the same data, switched by the toggle in the header: List (one card, hairline separators) and Cards (one card per account, drag handle at the left, drag to reorder; the order is saved in the config).
Under every usage bar a thin violet line shows how much of the window (5 h / 7 d) has already elapsed, so usage reads against pace. The hatched part of a bar is the FORECAST at reset: current usage plus the recent working-hours rate over the working hours left (Mon–Fri 09–19 by default, weekends count as zero; the 5 h session uses plain clock time). Hatching reaching the right edge = the limit will not last: the amber line under the reset time says when it runs out and how long before the reset. Any account with a window at 100% gets a red-tinted card. Expired token = one grey line, no request made. HTTP 429 = last snapshot dimmed with the retry time.

Settings popover under the gear: layout, countdown, hide expired logins; LOGIN FOLDERS — add a login folder or a parent of several (path or Browse), remove with ×, each row says what was found there; account order (same drag as in Cards), polling interval with the 60 s floor, warning/critical thresholds, server bind with LAN opt-in, desktop widget toggles. Values are samples.

Stats · by account: three columns = the three limit windows (session 5 h, all models 7 d, per model 7 d). Single hue per chart; the per-model chart has two series (Fable solid teal, Opus orange) with a legend in the filter row. Dashed ticks = window resets, red band = locked, amber band = no data; hover crosshair with time and value. Tiles: time locked, peak session, average session window, weekly pace with the projected day of hitting 100%.

Stats · by folder = by person (a credential folder is a seat; different accounts log into it over time). 30-day range. The strip above the charts shows WHO was logged in WHEN; the lines take that account's colour and break at a switch, so a jump in the level reads as a different account, not as usage. Same three windows; per model: solid = Fable, dashed = Opus. Palette teal / violet / orange validated for colour-blind separation on the Nova surface.
Honest limit: the endpoint counts per LOGIN. A folder's history is the concatenation of its logins' curves — usage cannot be split between two folders that share one login at the same time.

Theme tinted with the Nova site tokens (www/site/src/styles/global.css, dark scheme): bg #13111d with a soft violet glow (site accent-glow), surface #1e1a2e, alt #181526, border #322c4a, ink #e8e8ee / #9b95b5 / #6d6786, accent colour NOT used on controls, only the surfaces are tinted. Fonts as on the site: Manrope for UI, JetBrains Mono for numbers and paths.

Bar style is a setting (Settings → Bar style): Rounded (default) or Blocks — 8 px cells with a 2 px gap at a fixed pixel pitch (repeating gradient, so every gap is identical); the gap is a slightly darker shade of the same colour; a cell is either fully filled or fully empty (the fill snaps to whole cells, the bar width snaps to a whole number of cells, the exact percent stays in the number column); only the two outer ends rounded, the exact percent stays in the number column. Same markup in Cards view.
Round two: same content at three densities. C was chosen as the base; B and D kept for reference.
First-round light sketches, kept for reference only.
